facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: high potential incident - gravity exposure at HT-9006

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.
Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on HT-9006 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically identifying every energy source for a task. HT-9006 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during shift handover while the controlled removal of isolation and return to service had been bypassed. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 25 April 2025 a high potential incident was recorded on HT-9006 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during shift handover; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
